verdicts.reason: Both drop the praying-hands photo, which is the whole visual identity of the original, and leave plain white leaderboards with a stray black sliver at top centre. A at least centres the quote with even spacing around it, but it has a faint white-on-white cloud and cross fragment on the left that reads as an artifact, and the attribution floats far to the right. B is worse: the quote is pushed left, a detached black bar sits over empty space, and the tiny cross marks are clipped at the right edge.
